integrity: The proof uses the subgroup properties of kernel and image, the descendant-group homomorphism, kernel-coset constancy, exact-factorization splitting operators, and a self-contained analysis of the bijective case via crossed homomorphisms. A standalone exhaustive checker independently tests every set map S3->S3, the automorphism orbits, the involution action, and descendant group orders.
scientific_limitations: The classification is specific to the symmetric group S3 and the weight-1 group Rota-Baxter identity.
It does not classify linear Rota-Baxter operators on a group algebra or operators on larger symmetric groups.
A specialized or unindexed finite-group calculation may contain an equivalent S3 census.
title: The eight Rota–Baxter operators on \(S_3\)
